title: Uniqueness of quantum characteristic classes
html:
Proposition. Uniqueness of quantum characteristic classes

Fix a quantum observable universe and a recursive brane tower \{A_n\}_{n \ge 0}. Each quantum characteristic class \kappa_n \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B}) is uniquely determined as a cohomology class. Two Čech cocycles classifying the same central extension are cohomologous. They represent the same class \kappa_n.
